channel.title: The Chatham Daily News - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Chatham Daily News (chathamdailynews.ca)

item.title: Purple bench recognizes intimate partner violence, trafficking victims
item.description: A purple bench has been unveiled in Chatham's Zonta Park to support and honour victims of domestic violence, sexual assault and human trafficking.

item.title: Nominations open for this year's Black Excellence Awards
item.description: The Chatham-Kent Black Excellence Awards and Gala will return April 18, this time through a collaborative partnership.

item.title: Marchers celebrate International Women's Day
item.description: In a loud show of support for international women's day, more than 100 people marched through the streets of downtown Chatham on Sunday.

item.title: Clash causes single-vehicle crash, woman charged: Chatham-Kent police
item.description: A woman is charged after a clash between a driver and passenger led to a single-vehicle collision in Chatham Saturday night, said Chatham-Kent police.

item.title: Chatham Maroons start playoffs after winning regular-season crown
item.description: Assists aren’t awarded on shootout goals, but Chatham Maroons netminder Sammy DiBlasi deserves one.

item.title: PUC water, wastewaster master plan process will have public input
item.description: Chatham-Kent PUC is undertaking a water and wastewater master plan update study and will be seeking public input in the coming year.

item.title: Chatham-Kent home sales slow in February, average selling price drops
item.description: Home sales in Chatham-Kent were down in February despite an abundance of properties from which to choose.

item.title: Local roundup: Blades split two; Nicholas places fifth; Blain wins gold
item.description: The Blenheim Blades travel to Lakeshore Tuesday seeking a 2-1 series lead over the Canadiens in their PJHL Stobbs Division semifinal.
